profile.name: Loyalty Lead
profile.description: Runs your reward points program like a business: tracks what customers earn and spend, checks every market and product earns and redeems the way you intended, reminds loyal customers to use points before they drift away, keeps goodwill credits honest, and shows whether the program actually brings customers back.

listing.pitch: Your loyalty program manager: makes reward points bring customers back, and tells you what the program really costs.
highlights: Tracks points earned, spent and still owed, month by month
Checks every market has a points value and every product earns what you meant
Finds loyal customers sitting on unspent points who are going quiet
Catches autoship customers about to cancel with points still in their account
Reviews goodwill credits and refunds that leave points behind
Shows whether points customers reorder more than everyone else
example_prompts: How many points did customers earn and spend last month?
Roughly how much do we owe in unspent points?
Which loyal customers have lots of points but haven't ordered lately?
Does every country we sell in have a points value?
Do customers who use points reorder more often?
What would happen if we doubled points on autoship orders?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 9am: weekly loyalty review
On the 2nd at 9am: monthly points report
